s.zh:
天黄昏之年就会开始：敌人里的神力灌注者大幅增多，大规模袭击的领队可能被神明附体，击退附体者会掉神迹残片。

推荐路线：篡火者（难度很高）。
· 殖民者击败一名神明附体的首领时，篡火者之路自动开启（最后一击要由殖民者打中）。
· 试炼一：击败同一位神的附体首领 3 名；试炼二：完成被篡之神的事迹；最后在圣坛举行篡火仪式——成功率 = 50% + (心灵敏感度-1)×50% + 每片神迹残片 8%，最多 95%，失败会死。

开局的 5 片神迹残片可以留着提高篡火成功率。“神格学”已研究。
s.en:
, the twilight years begin: divinely infused enemies increase greatly, leaders of large raids may be possessed by gods, and driving off the possessed drops miracle fragments.

Recommended path: Fire Usurper (very hard).
· When a colonist defeats a god-possessed boss, the Path of the Fire Usurper opens automatically (a colonist must land the final blow).
· Trial 1: defeat 3 possessed bosses of the same god; Trial 2: complete the usurped god's deeds; finally hold the fire-usurping ritual at an altar. Success chance = 50% + (psychic sensitivity - 1) × 50% + 8% per miracle fragment, max 95%; failure means death.

The 5 starting miracle fragments can be kept to raise the fire-usurping success chance. "Theology of divinity" is already researched.
